Name: Ducati Flute
Author: SkylarkL
Description:
Replaces the vanilla horse flute to match CK's Ducati Motorbike, using colors lifted directly from it's spritesheet. That said, CK's Ducati Motorbike is not a requirement of this mod.

Most other mods should work with this - the only ones that will conflict will be ones that also replace the Horse Flute sprite.

[size=3]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]
